🧪  `glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.4`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.4

**Note:** this release contains a consenus breaking spec change for EIP-8037!

EELS branch: [`devnets/glamsterdam/8`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/devnets/glamsterdam/8)
Release notes: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.4
Test release tracker: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3518

**New in v8.1.4:**
- EIP-8037: successful child merges now use reservoir credit to repay the parent's outstanding state-gas spill into `gas_left`.
- EIP-8037: expanded cross-frame coverage across nested frames, call and create opcodes, delegation spills, funded reservoirs, execution reuse, and settlement.
- Additional EIP-7928, EIP-6110, transaction RLP, precompile coinbase, and withdrawal coverage.
